query: Latest news on Tarik Skubal trade status Detroit Tigers as of July 2026. Has any trade been completed or agreed yet? What is the timing expectation - trade close to August 3 deadline or earlier?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

**No Skubal trade has been completed or agreed as of mid-July 2026** — he remains a Detroit Tiger, and this is an active, unresolved deadline situation.

**On timing:** The 2026 MLB trade deadline is **August 3, 2026 at 6:00 p.m. ET**. All reporting points to any decision landing **close to the deadline, not earlier** — the Tigers front office is explicitly waiting to see how the team performs through late July before deciding whether to buy (keep) or sell (trade).

**Key context:** What was earlier a near-certain trade (with Detroit around 22-38) has been complicated by the Tigers going roughly 20-12 since June 1, pulling into Wild Card contention. Skubal himself (per Bob Nightengale) has said he "badly wants to stay" and has urged the team to buy. Insider consensus (e.g., FanSided's Robert Murray) still leans "a trade feels more likely than not," but retention is now a genuine possibility. Speculated suitors include the Dodgers, Yankees, Cubs, Braves, Brewers, and Rays.

One caveat on data quality: AskNews tools were unavailable (billing/subscription errors), so this relies on web search results, and standings figures vary slightly across articles depending on publication date within July.
